{{Quote|If it's peace both sides want, then peace you shall have. We Jedi are here to see that neither side is overcharged for its cost.|Mace Windu|<ref name="SW15" />}}
'''Peace negotiations''' between between the [[Lannik High Court|government]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lannik/Legends|Lannik]] and the rebellious [[Red Iaro/Legends|Red Iaro]] [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]], hosted on the planet [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] by its [[Gran Protectorate/Legends|Gran Protectorate]] and arbitrated by emissaries from the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi Council]], were conducted in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] as cover for a conspiracy to seize control of Lannik: the Red Iaro and Protectorate plotted with the [[Priest/Legends|priests]] of the [[Order of the Ffib]] to frame [[Lannik (species)|Lannik]] [[Prince/Legends|prince]] [[R'cardo Sooflie IX]] for the [[Death/Legends|deaths]] of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], allowing the terrorists to be awarded authority over their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. Though the negotiations were unfruitful, the Jedi survived the assassination attempt, uncovered the deception, and saved the life of Prince Sooflie.

==Prelude==
For [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior<ref name="SW13">[[Star Wars (1998) 13|''Star Wars'' (1998) 13]]</ref> to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="SW15" /> [[Lannik/Legends|Lannik]] was embroiled in a costly [[Lannik civil war|civil war]] between its [[Lannik High Court|government]] and the [[Red Iaro/Legends|Red Iaro]] [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] group, including a suicidal [[attack on Lannik's High Court]] by the terrorists, during with the lives of Lannik's [[R'cardo Sooflie IX's father|prince]] and a delegation of [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Diplomat/Legends|emissaries]] were saved by the intervention of the [[Lannik (species)/Legends|Lannik]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Even Piell/Legends|Even Piell]].<ref name="SW13" /> Backed by the [[Priest/Legends|priests]] of the [[Order of the Ffib]], the [[Gran Protectorate/Legends|Gran Protectorate]]<ref name="SW14" /> of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] planet [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]],<ref name="SW13" /> and elements of current Lannik prince [[R'cardo Sooflie IX]]'s [[Security guard/Legends|guard]], the Red Iaro conceived of a plot to win control of their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] by framing the prince for the [[Death/Legends|assassination]] of Jedi negotiators lured to Malastare under the pretext of negotiating a peace treaty between the Lannik factions.<ref name="SW16" /> The conspirators scheduled the negotiations to take place during the popular [[Vinta Harvest Classic/Legends|Vinta Harvest Classic]] [[Podracing/Legends|Podrace]], which served the dual purpose of initially drawing attention away from their scheme, and then providing media coverage for their deception.<ref name="SW14" />

[[Standard month/Legends|Months]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]] of the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation of Planets]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> by agreement with the Gran Protectorate,<ref name="SW15" /> [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and the [[Judicial Department/Legends|Judicial Department]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] requested that six members of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] travel from the Republic's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to Malastare to act as arbiters in the negotiations. Piell, by now a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] of the Council, took on the mission to put his knowledge of Lannik customs to use, and was joined by fellow councilors [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]], [[Yaddle/Legends|Yaddle]], [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], and [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]], in addition to Mundi's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] apprentice [[Darth Krayt|A'Sharad Hett]]. Gallia wished to complete the work of her parents&ndash;the Corellian emissaries rescued by Piell&ndash;<ref name="SW13" />and the Jedi Master served as the peace treaty's chief negotiator, while Master Windu was the mission's acting director,<ref name="SW15" /> owing to his status as a senior Council member.<ref name="SW13" />

Traveling to Malastare via [[Consular-class light cruiser/Legends|''Consular''-class cruiser]], the Jedi delegation was met by [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Senator/Legends|senators]] [[Baskol Yeesrim/Legends|Baskol Yeesrim]] and [[Ainlee Teem/Legends|Ainlee Teem]] and their [[Slavery/Legends|identured]] [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] servants, who escorted the emissaries to their quarters. En route through the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], they were tailed by a Ffib inquisitor and Red Iaro terrorist dispatched by Senator [[Aks Moe/Legends|Aks Moe]] of the Protectorate, who drew [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] and opened fire when confronted by Piell and Gallia before fleeing at the arrival of Mundi and Hett. The Gran guards' claimed ignorance of the attacker's passing, and their possession of [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]] in the controlled spaceport, led the Jedi to suspect treachery behind the scenes on the peace conference. Meanwhile, the assailants returned to Moe and a [[Unidentified Ffib priest|Ffib affiliate]] to confess their detection. The senator ordered a pair of [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] guards to kill the subordinates, and assured the priest that their plan would proceed unimpeded by their failure, promising the Jedi's deaths by the end of the following [[Standard day/Legends|day]].<ref name="SW14" />

==The negotiations==
The negotiators convened in the [[Governor's palace (Malastare)|palace]] of Gran [[Governor/Legends|governor]] [[Gujdim Wiphshun]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Pixelito/Legends|Pixelito]]. While waiting to be admitted to the governor's chambers, Hett was struck by a Gamorrean guard in an attempt to spark a conflict, which Master Yaddle defused through the use of a [[Mind trick/Legends|mindtrick]] on the instigator.<ref name="SW15" />

In the negotiation room, the Jedi introduced themselves to Sooflie and his [[Military Advisor]] [[Hutar Zash]], with whom Piell had served in the Lannik Palace guard. Upon learning of the Lannik Jedi's rescue of the former prince, his father, Sooflie remarked that where it not for the Jedi Master's actions, he would have assumed his place as prince much earlier. The Red Iaro delegation arrived last, led by [[Myk'chur Finux Zug]], among the terrorists fought previously by Piell. The Jedi Master accused Zug of cowardice and voiced his doubts at the sincerity of the Red Iaro's desire for peace. With a conciliatory word from Windu, Moe initiated the peace talks, though the Jedi emissaries [[Force sense/Legends|felt]] coming danger in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. In return for concessions from the Lannik government, Zug agreed to relinquish control of the captured [[Palesia]] territory. However, the prince took exception to the terrorist's use of crown lands as a bargaining chip, and decried the peace process as a mistake, leading Windu to call a recess for the day.<ref name="SW15" />

==Aftermath==
Hutar Zash, a covert agent of the Red Iaro, invited the Jedi aboard his personal [[EasyRide passenger airspeeder/Legends|airspeeders]]. Offering transport back to their quarters, he instead planned to detonate [[Thermite bomb/Legends|thermite bombs]] concealed on his person and that of his staff, killing the Jedi and his own men in view of the [[Cam droid/Legends|cam droids]] following the podrace over head. As the [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeders]] and podracers converged, Zash revealed his betrayal, explaining to Piell that he had been driven to the terrorists by the new prince's leadership. As the Military Advisor and his staff prepared for detonation, Piell bisected one airspeeder with his [[Even Piell's lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], allowing himself, Windu, and Gallia to fall free of the explosion, while the Jedi aboard the other [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] pitched their distracted captors over the side, their explosives going off in midair.<ref name="SW15" />

Taking hold of each other, the three falling Jedi clung to the connective cables of a passing [[Anakin Skywalker's Podracer/Legends|podracer]].<ref name="SW15" /> Unwilling to reveal their location by [[Telekinesis/Legends|levitating]] to the ground, Windu asked the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], the [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]], to decrease speed and allow the Jedi to jump to a nearby rooftop. Refusing to slow midrace, the racer instead struck at the Jedi's hand with a [[Wrench/Legends|wrench]] in an attempt to dislodge the unwanted passengers. Though Windu split the tool with his [[Mace Windu's blue-bladed lightsaber|lightsaber]], he was struck by the severed pieces and lost his grip, prompting Gallia to to embed a cable from her [[Liquid-cable launcher/Legends|grappling spike launcher]] in the pod's fuselage. At the same time, [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Aldar Beedo/Legends|Aldar Beedo]], hired by fellow racer [[Wan Sandage/Legends|Wan Sandage]] to kill Sebulba, approached and took aim at his target. As the Dug drew a blaster to shoot down the Jedi, Beeda fired his [[Aldar Beedo's blaster pistol|own weapon]], severing Gallia's cable and leaving the Jedi to fall into the other airspeeder, commandeered by Yaddle and Hett and waiting below.<ref name="SW16" />

Reunited, the Jedi deduced the nature of the deception, with Piell speculating that the conspirators sought to exploit the natural resources of Lannik, and Windu concluding that, due to the failure of their gambit, they would shift their target to the prince, who, even with their personal misgivings, the Jedi sought to protect. Sooflie's chambers were breached by Red Iaro forces led by Zug and the Ffib priest, who killed the prince's guards despite their secret allegiance to the terrorist organization, and prepared to feed the prince to a pair of [[Akk dog/Legends|akk dogs]], beasts native to Mace Windu's homeworld<ref name="SW16" /> [[Haruun Kal/Legends|Haruun Kal]],<ref name="Shatter">[[Shatterpoint (novel)|''Shatterpoint'']]</ref> at once disposing of Sooflie and the evidence of their crime. They were interrupted by the arrival of the Jedi, who crashed their airspeeder through a window and engaged the intruders. While Mundi and his Padawan fought the Lannik terrorists, the Jedi Masters eliminated the threat of the akk dogs: one fell to the [[Yaddle's lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] of Yaddle, while the other was pacified by the bond its kind shared with Windu's [[Koruun|people]]. Their plot foiled, the conspirators attempted to flee. While the priest was suspended in the air by Plo Koon's Force grip, Zug shed his [[Jacket/Legends|jacket]] to expose a [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpack]], and escaped through the broken window into the [[Engine/Legends|engine]] turbine of Sebulba's oncoming podracer.<ref name="SW16" />

Entering the chambers, Senator Moe took custody of the priest before his part in the conspiracy was revealed, promising to investigate the circumstances of the beasts' presence in the governor's palace. With the peace talks canceled, Prince Sooflie departed and the Jedi Councilors returned to Coruscant, save Windu, who, troubled by the akk dogs' use as weapons and having learned in the altercation that they had been acquired from [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], embarked on a [[Mission to Nar Shaddaa (Mace Windu)|mission]] there to investigate the illicit trade.<ref name="SW16" />
